zh-Hans:
• 修复语音对话中同一次发言重复发送，保留正常重复提问和手动发送。
• 普通聊天与语音对话复用已启用、已授权的工具，完善时间与按需定位信息。
• 增加 Skill Hub 技能详情和官方技能直接下载安装流程，统一卡片布局。
• 修复新建任务、会话和语音聊天输入框的长文换行、展开和草稿保留。
• 会话长按菜单增加多选和置顶，移除逐行更多按钮，使用原生多选工具栏。
• 网页服务运行终端增加浏览器快捷入口，复用已选端口和页面。
en-US:
• Fixed duplicate sends of one spoken utterance while preserving intentional repeats and manual sends.
• Chat and voice conversations use enabled tools within existing permissions, with clearer time and on-demand location support.
• Added Skill Hub details and direct downloads for reviewed official skills, with consistent card layouts.
• Fixed wrapping, expansion and draft retention for long messages in new tasks, conversations and voice chat.
• Added multiple selection and persistent pinning through conversation context menus, removed per-row More buttons and adopted native selection toolbars.
• Added a browser shortcut in web-service run terminals, reusing the selected port and page.
